title: Legacy program rumored to lure UFOs with psionic assets

tellings.quote: There are rumors that the legacy UFO program itself uses protocols to attract UFOs to come in.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there are rumors that the "legacy" UFO program, a long-running secret government effort some people say exists, uses protocols to draw UFOs in. The idea is that people with psychic or mind-based abilities are used to attract the craft, which would mean the government can call them on purpose.
